name: Ultimate Online defensive movement library (Defensive Intelligence 3.0)

rig.axes: Y up, character faces +Z, +X = character left

conventions.root_motion: In place: only Hips Y moves. The game owns position and facing; turning clips give root_turn_deg / root_turn_keys (+ = left) that the game applies to the root over root_turn_window_s.
conventions.speed: implied_ground_speed = how fast the planted foot travels under the body (m/s). Scale playback so it matches the real velocity to avoid foot sliding: rate = game_speed / implied speed.
conventions.foot_contacts: foot_contacts_s lists every grounded interval per foot, measured on the exported animation.
conventions.additive: 06_additive_tracking clips hold only upper-body tracks; frame 0 is the neutral reference. three.js: THREE.AnimationUtils.makeClipAdditive(clip, 0) then play with blendMode = THREE.AdditiveAnimationBlendMode over the locomotion.

reuse.MASS: Tackles are not in this library: DEF_PRE_TACKLE clips end in a pose that blends (6-8 frames) into the defender clips of the existing MASS tackle pairs.
reuse.BALLSYNC: Catches/swats/interceptions are not in this library: DEF_PASS_CONTEST_ENTRY / CB19 / S12 end in poses that blend into the BallSync defender clips; S14 follows a BallSync interception.
